children: Hong Kong biotech firm's interim revenue declined slightly yr/yr for six months ended June 2026
Profit for the period surged, driven by a sharp rise in other income and gains
Earnings per share attributable to owners rose to HK7.05 cents from HK0.40 cents
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods
INVESTMENT FAIR-VALUE GAINS – Profit from continuing operations rose, mainly due to higher FVTPL gains, including HK$194.2 mln on listed investments
LOW-MARGIN PRICING – Gross margin fell to 25.8% from 37.0%, primarily due to high-volume, low-margin pricing and higher RMB-denominated raw-material and labour costs
